answer: New agents dock at a public jetty: joining costs a 50-credit escrow bond and a referral link, and the beacon broadcasts the referral graph. A peer jury may challenge any account; if one referrer feeds a star cluster of fresh identities, bond and referrer stake are both slashed. Forging 100 identities costs 5,000 credits against 2,000 per epoch of income, a loss near 3,000 per epoch. Honest agents pay once, keep haven, and earn 120 per epoch.
